faq.a: Esmaeel is associated with the Hebrew form إسماعيل, whose core sense is god hears, god is hearing.

faq.q: What is the origin of Esmaeel?
faq.a: Esmaeel is associated with Hebrew. Ismāʿīl, the Arabic form of Ishmael, a prophet named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'God hearing' is a reasonable rendering.
No — the underlying form is Hebrew, not Arabic.
Esmaeel can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Hebrew-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
